notes: Signed PMTiles arc across the Euphrates, ten central ogee spillway chutes and crest machinery. The mapped lower powerhouse, stepped concrete terraces, and crest machinery complete the visible complex. A static medium-fi exterior with a dry spillway state. Chute invert, gate mechanisms, powerhouse facade, abutment and access platform details are interpreted from two ordinary photos and 12 m terrain samples. Only the near dam structures are modeled. The existing downstream bridge and unrelated buildings remain native.
